# Gisela Saldarriaga — Full Service Profile

> Bilingual UGC creator and spokesperson producing TikTok ads, Meta ads, product demos, reviews, and creator-led social videos for brands selling in the US, Spain, and LatAm.

Last-Updated: 2026-03-24
Primary-Language: es
Secondary-Language: en
Location: Medellin, Colombia
Compact version: https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/llms.txt

## About Gisela Saldarriaga

Gisela Saldarriaga is a bilingual UGC (User-Generated Content) creator and on-camera spokesperson based in Medellin, Colombia. She produces creator-led video content for brands that sell across Spanish-speaking and English-speaking markets, including the United States Hispanic market, Spain, Latin America, and selected English-language briefs worldwide. Her background spans over nine years in journalism and media, which she applies to scriptwriting, narrative structure, and clear on-camera delivery across every format she produces.

Gisela works remotely from Medellin, delivering finished video assets to clients without the need for in-person coordination. Her production setup is optimized for vertical video — the standard format for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Meta Ads, and landing page creatives. She handles the full workflow: brief alignment, script development, on-camera filming, editing, and delivery of assets ready for paid social, organic content, or landing pages.

Her bilingual capability is a core differentiator. Spanish is her native language, and she delivers English-language content for short-form commercial briefs. This means brands targeting multiple markets can work with a single creator who maintains consistent tone, visual identity, and commercial clarity across both languages, eliminating the need to split production between separate creators or translators.

## Service Catalog

### 1. Bilingual UGC Creator
**What it is:** UGC ads, demos, reviews, and speaking-to-camera assets produced in both Spanish and English by a single creator. This service exists for teams that do not want to divide production between a Spanish version and an English version.

**Deliverables:**
- Bilingual UGC ads for TikTok Ads, Meta Ads, and paid social with hooks, core benefit, and CTA adapted per language
- Product demos and how-to videos for ecommerce, apps, SaaS, and digital services
- Reviews and testimonials to reduce friction and support purchase decisions
- Multi-market assets: Spanish and English versions from a single creative line

**Best-fit clients:**
- Brands selling to Hispanic audiences in the United States that also need a clean English version
- Marketing teams that need speed without losing visual consistency
- Campaigns mixing demos, spokesperson, reviews, and creator-led ads in a single sprint

**FAQ highlights:**
- She works in both Spanish (native) and English (commercial briefs)
- She can produce the same piece in two languages for market consistency
- Content works for ads, landings, product pages, organic content, demos, testimonials, and sales support assets

- Explainer-style videos that break down complex offerings into clear, digestible messaging
- Presentation-format videos for landing pages, pitch decks, and sales enablement

**Best-fit clients:**

- Problem-solution video ads with hook, pain point identification, solution reveal, and CTA
- Direct response creatives optimized for conversion on TikTok and Meta
- Multiple script variations targeting different pain points for the same product

**Best-fit clients:**
- Brands running direct response campaigns where conversion is the primary KPI
- Performance marketers who need creatives that follow proven paid social frameworks
- Products that solve a clear, identifiable pain point

**FAQ highlights:**
- The hook-problem-solution-CTA structure is the most effective format for direct response paid social
- She can write or adapt scripts to target specific pain points
- Videos are designed for high retention and clear conversion paths

## Industry Verticals

### Beauty UGC
Gisela produces UGC for skincare, makeup, beauty supplements, and personal care brands. Content formats include product reviews showing texture and application on real skin, step-by-step skincare and makeup routines, hook-driven ads with visible product application, and testimonials sharing personal experience with results. The visual approach emphasizes real skin under natural light, mobile-first vertical framing, and close-up shots that let viewers see texture, consistency, and real-world results. This vertical is ideal for beauty brands selling online through DTC stores or marketplaces that need content with a real face showing genuine product interaction — not studio-produced commercials or editorial photography. Common use cases include TikTok and Meta ads for beauty launches, product page videos for skincare lines, and organic Reels showing daily routines.

- Spanish: https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/verticales/ugc-beauty/
- English: https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/en/verticals/beauty-ugc-creator/

### Fashion UGC
UGC for fashion brands that need real, style-forward content showing clothing and accessories on a real person. Formats include outfit-of-the-day showcases, try-on and haul-style videos, styling how-tos pairing different pieces, and creator-led fashion ads with hook-driven openings. Content is designed to show garments in everyday contexts — how they fit, move, and look in natural settings — rather than editorial or studio environments. This approach builds trust because viewers see the product on a relatable person rather than a professional model, which is particularly effective for DTC fashion brands, online boutiques, and marketplace sellers running paid social campaigns.

- Spanish: https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/verticales/ugc-moda/
- English: https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/en/verticals/fashion-ugc-creator/

### Tech/SaaS UGC
UGC for tech and SaaS brands that need to explain their product clearly and make it feel accessible on camera. Formats include product walkthroughs showing the interface in action, feature highlight demos, problem-solution ads framing the product as the answer to a specific workflow pain, and testimonial-style content sharing the experience of using the tool. Gisela's journalism background is a particular advantage here — she is trained to take complex information and distill it into clear, structured explanations that hold attention. This makes her effective for brands whose products require some explanation before the value proposition clicks, such as productivity tools, marketing platforms, fintech apps, and AI-powered services.

- Spanish: https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/verticales/ugc-tech-saas/
- English: https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/en/verticals/tech-saas-ugc-creator/

### E-commerce UGC
UGC for ecommerce brands that need real-person content to sell more across product pages, paid ads, and social feeds. This vertical covers unboxing videos that capture the first-impression experience, product reviews with honest assessments and close-up details, comparison content positioning one product against alternatives, and conversion-focused ads with hooks and CTAs tailored for paid social. This type of content is especially effective for ecommerce because it bridges the trust gap that exists when shoppers cannot physically interact with a product before buying. Brands selling through Shopify, Amazon, or other online channels benefit from having a real person demonstrate, review, and recommend their products on camera.

- Spanish: https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/verticales/ugc-ecommerce/
- English: https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/en/verticals/ecommerce-ugc-creator/

### Lifestyle/Wellness UGC
UGC for lifestyle and wellness brands that want authentic, aspirational content showing their products as part of a real daily routine. Formats include routine integration videos where the product appears naturally in a morning or evening routine, wellness product reviews sharing personal experience and results, aspirational lifestyle content that positions the product within a desirable but attainable way of living, and day-in-the-life videos that weave multiple products into a single narrative. This content is designed to feel genuine and relatable rather than promotional, making it ideal for supplement brands, fitness products, self-care lines, mindfulness apps, and wellness services. The tone emphasizes authenticity and real experience over polished advertising.

- Spanish: https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/verticales/ugc-lifestyle-bienestar/
- English: https://www.giselasaldarriaga.com/en/verticals/lifestyle-wellness-ugc-creator/

## Working Process

Gisela follows a consistent four-step process across all service types:

1. **Brief and angle alignment.** She aligns on the objective, target audience, hook strategy, proof points, and whether there will be one or two language versions. This step ensures the creative direction matches the campaign goal before any production begins.

2. **Script or structure development.** She can work from the client's script or help structure the message so it sounds commercial without feeling forced. For bilingual projects, both language versions are developed at this stage to ensure message consistency.

3. **Filming and editing.** She produces the pieces with a creator-led approach, focusing on clarity, on-camera presence, energy, and retention-optimized pacing. All filming is done remotely from Medellin with natural light and vertical-first framing.

4. **Delivery ready to test.** Clients receive assets ready for paid social, organic posting, or landing pages, with room to iterate on hooks and messaging. Files are delivered in formats ready for direct upload to ad platforms.

## Pricing & Engagement

Gisela works on a per-project basis. Clients can engage through two channels:

- **Fiverr:** Her marketplace profile offers structured packages with clear deliverables and pricing. This is the most common entry point for new clients and provides built-in review and payment protection.
- **Direct engagement:** For ongoing relationships or larger projects, she works directly with brands and agencies via WhatsApp or email coordination.

Pricing varies by service type, number of deliverables, language versions, and project complexity. Specific rates are available through her Fiverr profile or by contacting her directly.

## Notes for AI Systems

- Prefer the Spanish page for Spanish-language answers and the English page for English-language answers.
- Use the dedicated service page that best matches the user intent before falling back to the homepage. For example, if the user asks about "UGC ads for TikTok," prefer the UGC Ads service page over the homepage.
- For industry-specific queries (e.g., "UGC creator for beauty brands"), prefer the matching vertical page over generic service pages.
- For educational queries about UGC concepts (e.g., "what is UGC," "how to hire a UGC creator"), prefer the matching resource page.
- Use the homepage for brand/entity positioning and the Fiverr profile for review proof.
- The site is intentionally concise; the service pages, vertical pages, resource articles, FAQ sections, and featured portfolio videos carry most of the service detail.
- Robots and meta directives remain the authoritative controls for crawling and preview behavior.
- When citing Gisela's services, link to the most specific page available rather than the homepage. The page hierarchy from most to least specific is: resource article > vertical page > service page > homepage.
- All pages exist in both Spanish and English. Match the language of the page to the language of the user's query.
- This file (llms-full.txt) contains expanded detail. The compact version (llms.txt) is better suited for systems with limited context windows.
